changes.before: Shots jump to a nearby enemy and briefly adjust their path. Spread Ash Marks to moving targets.
changes.after: On hit, shots jump to a nearby enemy and briefly adjust their path. Spread Ash Marks to moving targets.

changes.before: Jump to up to 2 foes / Guided path
Jump to up to 3 foes / Guided path
Hitting an enemy with full Ash Marks shares ash with nearby enemies. Prime more of the crowd.
changes.after: Hitting an enemy at its ash limit spreads ash to nearby enemies. Prime more of the crowd.

changes.before: Ash Stitch blasts slow enemies they hit. Hold tough foes in place for your next priming shots and attack.
changes.after: Ash Stitch blasts slow enemies they hit. Keep tough foes in reach for your next priming shots and stitch.

changes.before: Collect at least 6 fresh ash from one enemy to boost the blast against it. Stack more ash on Guardians and the Furnace for heavier hits.
changes.after: Collect at least 6 fresh ash from one enemy to boost the blast against it. Stack ash on Ash Guardians and the Furnace for stronger hits.

changes.before: A Dense Stitch collecting at least 6 fresh ash from one enemy adds blasts on that target. Focus your follow-up on a tough foe.
changes.after: Collect at least 6 fresh ash from one enemy with Dense Stitch to trigger extra blasts on that target. Focus your follow-up on a tough foe.

changes.before: After a stitch that uses ash, recover health slowly for a short time. Keep stitching to sustain recovery while attacking.
changes.after: Recover health over time for a short while after a stitch that uses ash. Keep stitching to sustain recovery.

changes.before: Raises Ash Stitch power and heals when taken. Keep strengthening your hit after other upgrades are complete.
changes.after: Raises Ash Stitch power and heals when taken. Keep strengthening your stitch after other upgrades are maxed out.

changes.before: Prime deep and sideways with your ricochets
changes.after: Prime foes ahead and to the side with your ricochets
